<function name="WasKeyPressed" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether a key was initially pressed in the same frame this function was called.

This function only works in Move hooks, and will detect key presses even in main menu or when a typing in a text field.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number">The key, see <page>Enums/KEY</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the key was initially pressed the same frame that this function was called, false otherwise.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
